summary: Adds `valid_ordering_lookups = {'isnull'}` to Options, matching Django's actual accepted approach for allowing the isnull lookup in ordering (ticket #30293). Correct minimal fix; only concern is the narrow whitelist, which is intentional scope.

issues.description: Only 'isnull' is whitelisted. Other boolean-producing lookups usable in order_by still raise E015. Acceptable/intended scope (isnull is the common orderable lookup) but not a fully general lookup-vs-transform fix.
New attribute introduced with no inline comment explaining why only 'isnull' is permitted in ordering; a one-line comment would aid maintainability.
